title: Minuta 2025-02-06
summary: The minutes of the 6 February meeting confirm the 50bp cut to 9.50% (4-1), justified by notable disinflation progress, core near its pre-pandemic average, a Q4 contraction and a real ex-ante rate still above 6% and well above neutral. Two members explicitly say a similar 50bp cut could be contemplated at the next meeting and a third wants calibration to proceed at higher speed in some decisions, so the easing bias is strong. But the minutes read somewhat less dovish than the communique: the member backing the second 50bp move stresses emphatically that this does not mean a cycle of 50bp cuts toward neutrality, another wants the stance kept restrictive throughout the year, and Heath's dissent is sharp, citing 'severe doubts' about continued disinflation, calling growth worries secondary and asking for very gradual easing with the real rate kept between 5% and 6%. This is the first minutes of 2025 in the base, so the comparison is with the communique of the same meeting, where the 'similar magnitude' guidance read as an open-ended acceleration.

key_quotes.quote: Agregó que en la siguiente reunión podría contemplarse un recorte de igual tamaño.
key_quotes.context: A member backs a second 50bp cut at the next meeting

key_quotes.quote: Comentó de manera enfática que no prevé un ciclo de recortes de esa magnitud que lleve la tasa a un nivel de neutralidad próximamente.
key_quotes.context: Same member caps the message: no 50bp cycle to neutrality

key_quotes.quote: Señaló que pese al avance desinflacionario, en su opinión existen severas dudas sobre su continuación.
Indicó que en los próximos meses el relajamiento de la postura debería ser muy gradual, para que la tasa real ex ante se ubique entre 5 y 6%, procurando no cruzar la cota inferior de dicho rango.
key_quotes.context: Dissenter asks for very gradual easing and a real-rate floor
